title: Support safe decision edits and distinct deferral
head: Commit containing this receipt; exact published head and normal hook results recorded in PR description.

dependencies.stack: User-requested F stack on corrected F13; keep PRs open and unmerged. Optional Q05 fact owner integration.

baseline_review.comparison: A15 matches F13 and reviewed main. A13 matches F13; main adds bounded approval labels to preserve when integrating. D08 supplies presentation and confirmation, Q05 supplies recipient/connection/computer binding checks.
baseline_review.parent_ci: Corrected F13 Tests, Docker and active platform checks pass.

figma.visual: Backend and workflow engine only; no UI activation or screenshot. D07/D08 retain presentation ownership.

implementation: Bounded typed plain-text Gmail and Calendar event adapters; unknown, rich and opaque actions remain read-only. No generic argument or auth editor.
Atomic immutable revision/approval replacement, old approval expiry, stable queue/work identity and placement, generation-fenced effect writes and dispatch claims.
Durable Keep draft and expiry retention without workflow resume, explicit rejection, fresh review on reopen, idempotent request receipts and authenticated recovery routes.
Versioned full-document handoff from daemon to engine processed input before action context conversion; cache registration and re-vendoring patch.
Optional Q05 fact owner recaptures new recipient bindings while retaining original identities for unchanged recipients. Authority, cancellation and binding checks retain their owners.

affected.note: Includes real engine build and all affected workflow Authority users. Final document status projection also rechecked in focused suite and normal commit hooks.

focused.includes: Two independent processes racing save/approve, reload/expiry/deferral, lost responses, typed parameter dispatch, authenticated HTTP, unsupported payloads and status projection.

actual_q05.method: Temporary overlay of actual fact-bindings.ts, removed in finally. New recipient pins, retained deleted dependency and stale recipient rejection. Not a full F/Q stack merge.

fixes: Treat a positive single-ID claim count as success when queue triggers add changed rows.
Project a blocked effect ahead of the earlier permission grant.
Resolve historical approval aliases to the stable decision so exact lost-response retries recover the original receipt.

mutations.note: Removing only the scheduler prefilter remains protected by its transactional recheck; removing both fails the deferral and expiry tests.

typescript.note: Normal commit hook reruns TypeScript after the final edits.

verification.guards: Normal EE, migration, template, package, related tests and TypeScript hooks required before push; exact results in PR description.
verification.live_provider: Not run. Tests use temporary databases, a Unix socket and the real engine guard with isolated dispatch input; no email/calendar effect or production activation.

initial_hooks.guards: EE, migrations, templates, package and TypeScript all pass. Final alias correction reruns normal hooks; exact result in PR.

limitations: Gmail HTML, attachments, reply threads, custom senders and provider-side draft mutation are read-only. Calendar requires explicit end and timezone; calendar/notification/guest options stay fixed.
D08 must bind the typed document and correlate receipts before moving the stack; no live UI binding is included.
Q05 and main overlap the runtime files; preserve their validation and bounded-label changes. The guide records integration details.
Existing workflow piece retry semantics remain; authorization is not a provider completion or exactly-once delivery receipt.
Readiness and flag gates keep this default off. Full repository CI reports separately on the PR.
rollback: Unset decision-edits flag on the new runtime and restart; retain schema, revisions, receipts and expired approvals. Do not downgrade the protocol with edited/deferred work pending.

fixes.change: Resume pre-F14 approvals and recorded retries with their exact historical request digest, across restart with either flag setting. Legacy effects remain read-only; changed targets and protocol downgrades remain refused.
Display effective Calendar guest-invite and guest-visibility defaults as true when omitted, preserve explicit false, and leave outgoing permissions unchanged.
Overlay approved editable fields into the censored persisted run input and compressed execution-state backup as well as action input. Preserve auth redaction and fixed options.

regressions.method: Remove the three fixes temporarily, run the unchanged regression suite, restore source bytes in finally, verify restoration, and rerun. Synthetic provider actions only.

verification.normal_commit_hooks: Required before push; exact published head and hook results recorded in PR description.
verification.limitations: Six affected-suite skips require optional Q-track modules. Synthetic Gmail/Calendar pieces exercise the real engine and persisted backup without live provider calls. No UI activation or screenshot.
